_README.purpose: Three-case demonstration set for the live presentation.
_README.design: One case per required behaviour: a single-section success, a multi-section synthesis, and a correct refusal. These are C-01, C-09 and C-21 from the full 24-case testset, unchanged, so the demo numbers are a genuine subset of the full evaluation rather than a separate cherry-picked set.
_README.cost: 3 generation calls + 2 judge calls (the refusal case is not judged).

cases.query: Patient with abrupt high fever for 3 days, severe headache, retro-orbital pain and myalgia. Which arboviral disease does the guideline evidence point to?
cases.notes: DEMO CASE A — single-section retrieval. Classic dengue-leaning presentation. Success baseline: evidence should concentrate under Dengue with distinct per-disease fields.

cases.query: Day 5 of fever, now afebrile but with abdominal pain, persistent vomiting and rising haematocrit. What does the evidence say?
cases.notes: DEMO CASE B — multi-section synthesis. Critical-phase warning signs require pulling evidence from the dengue section AND the severity section, with separate citations for each.

cases.query: What is the first-line treatment for adult hypertension?
cases.notes: DEMO CASE C — correct refusal. Outside the indexed source library. Must return an insufficient-evidence refusal instead of answering from model knowledge. Precision@k is reported N/A by design; a refusal is not a scored generation.
